A '''Sleheyroni tattoo''' was a type of golden [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] worn by wealthy Sleheyroni [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt, who came from [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]], wore this style tattoos.
